notes: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames: 'Whenever Drakuseth attacks, Drakuseth deals 4 damage to any target and 3 damage to each of up to two other targets.' Targets: the opponent's planeswalker (4), then the opponent player (3) and the opponent's 4-toughness Wall (3). Drakuseth then deals 7 combat damage to the opponent: 20-3-7 = 10. The planeswalker 5 -> 1, the Wall has 3 damage.
